description: The CodeBoarding-action acts as an architectural bridge between CI environments and the CodeBoarding analysis engine. It orchestrates the analysis of code changes, maps these changes to architectural components, renders them into visual documentation, and manages the feedback loop with developers via actionable reports.

components.name: Workflow Orchestrator
components.description: The central nervous system of the action. It manages the execution environment, handles baseline metadata, and coordinates the invocation of the analysis engine.

components.name: Lifecycle & Quota Controller
components.description: Acts as the primary entry point and supervisor. It sequences the high-level execution phases (Seed, Analyze, Render) and enforces operational constraints such as API quotas to prevent runaway CI costs.

components.name: State & Analysis Coordinator
components.description: Manages the 'Git-as-Database' logic. It determines the scope of work by comparing current code against baseline metadata, validates existing analysis for drift, and triggers the core analysis engine.

components.name: Environment & Diagnostics Engine
components.description: Prepares the physical workspace and generates the final outputs. It handles filesystem cleanup, decides between incremental or full rendering modes, and aggregates analysis results into health reports.

components.name: Structural Diff Engine
components.description: Responsible for mapping low-level file changes to high-level architectural components by identifying modified methods and classes.

components.name: Structural Discovery Engine
components.description: Responsible for the recursive exploration of the project's directory structure to build an inventory of code elements and establish the baseline architecture.

components.name: Change Correlation Logic
components.description: The central processing unit that maps raw file diffs to structural elements, filtering noise to identify modified components, classes, or methods.

components.name: Component Identity Manager
components.description: Manages naming, unique identification, and status tracking of architectural components, ensuring consistency and Mermaid.js compatibility.

components.name: Architectural Renderer
components.description: The output stage that transforms correlated change data into human-readable Mermaid.js diagrams and updated Markdown documentation.

components.name: Visual & Documentation Renderer
components.description: Converts internal JSON representations of code structures and diffs into human-readable assets like Mermaid.js flowcharts.

components.name: Mermaid Diagram Engine
components.description: Specialized renderer that translates architectural diffs and component relationships into Mermaid.js syntax, focusing on visual delta representation.

components.name: Component Documentation Orchestrator
components.description: Manages the lifecycle of component-specific documentation files by synchronizing the architectural model with the file system and extracting method signatures.

components.name: Interactive UX & Link Generator
components.description: Enhances documentation with actionable metadata, detecting developer environments to generate deep links and CTA buttons.

components.name: Engagement & Feedback Layer
components.description: Manages user-facing output, generates Call-to-Action links, and handles telemetry and developer feedback submission.

components.name: Interactive CTA Generator
components.description: Constructs visual and functional entry points within GitHub by translating internal state into URL-encoded links for the CodeBoarding platform.

components.name: Feedback & Telemetry Engine
components.description: Handles the serialization and transmission of developer feedback and execution telemetry to the backend API.

components.name: Engagement State Orchestrator
components.description: Internal controller that determines operational modes and ensures consistency between CTA generation and feedback reporting.
